# British television

The Prisoner is a television work with selected written episode tellings and an independently housed programme identity. The Village is a narrated confinement setting; the British production world is a different geographical relation. The 1967–68 series and its episode order remain distinct from later episode summaries and Taylor’s reading.

The [geographical route](../../atlas/geography/README.md) and [temporal route](../../atlas/temporality/README.md) **returns-to** these same wholes.
